description: A side profile view of a single soccer cleat against a white background. The cleat is predominantly bright pink and metallic silver, with a textured, almost splattered pattern. It features a prominent Nike swoosh logo in a gradient of purple and blue. On the heel, there is a silver stylized 'NJR' logo, associated with Neymar Jr. The shoe has pink laces, a pink sock-like collar, and a pink soleplate with purple-tipped studs.

A rear view of a pair of bright pink Nike soccer cleats against a clean white background. The shoes feature blue and purple accents. The left heel is customized with the text 'VINI VOA' in blue, while the right heel has 'VINI FLY'. A silver 'AIR' logo is visible on the outer side of the left cleat, and a partial Nike swoosh is visible on the right.

A top-down studio photograph of a pair of soccer cleats. The cleats are predominantly a vibrant, fluorescent pink with a distressed silver pattern on the upper. They have matching pink laces. The interior of the shoes features a dark blue insole with a pink logo, which appears to be a stylized 'VIR' with a Nike swoosh above it. The background is a clean, solid white.

A side profile view of a single soccer cleat against a white background. The cleat is predominantly bright pink and metallic silver. The upper has a textured, splattered pattern with pink over the silver base. It features a large Nike swoosh logo on the side, which is colored with a gradient of purple to blue and outlined in silver. The laces are pink. The heel area displays a silver stylized logo, 'NJR', for Neymar Jr. The shoe has a low-cut, sock-like collar. The soleplate is pink with purple-tipped studs.
on_running_details: This is a Nike product, not related to On Running.
